subject: naval-operations
title: Case III — Tomcat recovery exercise
objective: Practise modeled navigation, timing, radio choices and configuration in a synthetic recovery scenario.
applicability: F-14B / DCS-oriented educational exercise; simulator version not verified.

module.title: Case III Recoveries
module.objective: Understand the fixed-wing recovery sequence, marshal, navigation, timing, communications and recovery outcomes; then practise selected skills in a standalone Tomcat exercise.
module.applicability: Aircraft-agnostic fixed-wing concepts with historical US Navy training examples; type-specific procedures remain separate.

subject: flight-fundamentals
title: Autorotation — engine failure exercise
objective: Fly a helicopter engine failure to the ground in a side view: lower the collective, set the autorotation airspeed, keep rotor rpm in the green, then flare, level and cushion.
applicability: Invented light single-engine helicopter over flat ground in calm wind; educational flight model, not any real type.

module.title: Autorotation Practice
module.objective: Understand what an engine failure does to a helicopter's rotor and the sequence that answers it, entry, steady descent, flare and touchdown, and how the right first cyclic input depends on the speed you start from; then fly it in a standalone exercise.
module.applicability: Single-rotor helicopters with a freewheeling unit, for military pilots of every service; each type's flight manual gives its own autorotation airspeed, rotor rpm and technique.
